propositions: inspect-ai is never imported in src/ and is the sole member of the [eval] extra, making it an unused dependency
the [eval] extra creates two [tool.uv] conflicts entries (eval vs bedrock, eval vs dev) and a click override that are only needed to accommodate inspect-ai
removing inspect-ai enables the previously conflicting dev+bedrock environment combination to coexist and allows eval tests to join the normal test suite
the eval.py module docstring falsely claims inspect-ai routing that the implementation explicitly disclaims as an abandoned design
every reference to the live eval run needing [eval] must be corrected to name [agents], which is what the actual pydantic-ai solver requires
